Register machines you provisioned, or hand the panel a blank VPS and let it do it.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Full**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/servers`

Every server with status, site count and host key.

- **Level:** Read only

### `POST /api/servers`

Register a server, or provision a blank VPS over SSH.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `{name, sshHost, sshPort?, sshUser?, devDomain, dnsProvider?, publicIp?, provision?, acmeEmail?}`
- **Returns:** `201 {server, checks, job} | 202 when provisioning`

### `GET /api/servers/ssh-public-key`

The key to authorize on a new machine.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{publicKey}`

### `GET /api/servers/:id`

One server.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/servers/:id/info`

What the machine is: OS, kernel, CPU, memory, uptime, Docker version.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?refresh=true skips the one-minute cache`
- **Returns:** `{reachable, os, kernel, arch, cpus, memTotalBytes, uptimeSeconds, dockerVersion, …}`

### `PATCH /api/servers/:id`

Edit a server, re-trust its host key, or set where it keeps backups.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `{name?, sshHost?, sshPort?, sshUser?, publicIp?, devDomain?, dnsProvider?, retrustHostKey?, backupRoot?}`

### `POST /api/servers/:id/test`

Re-verify the connection now.

- **Level:** Manage. Only re-checks the connection; changes nothing
- **Returns:** `{ok, checks}`

### `POST /api/servers/:id/update`

Re-push the provision bundle and re-run setup.sh.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{rootUser?: "root"}`

### `GET /api/servers/:id/storage`

Where backups live on this server, and whether a candidate path would work.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?path= to validate instead`

### `POST /api/servers/:id/backups/relocate`

Copy every backup to a new location, verify, remove the originals.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Job · Destructive
- **Input:** `{to}`

### `GET /api/servers/:id/terminal`

Interactive root shell.

Websocket upgrade - not callable from the test console.

- **Level:** Full. A root shell on the server
- **Notes:** Destructive · Not over MCP
- **Input:** `?cols=&rows=`

### `DELETE /api/servers/:id`

Remove a server (refused while sites live on it; server 1 never).

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `?force=true`

### `GET /api/monitor/overview`

Per-server load/memory/disk and per-site up/CPU/memory/disk.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/monitor/servers/:id/history`

Server resource history for charts.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?hours=1..168`

### `GET /api/monitor/sites/:slug/history`

Site resource history for charts.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Input:** `?hours=1..168`
